dateline: With the ARIRANG World Tour paused between Chicago and Los Angeles, BTS's off-stage numbers keep climbing: the Korean Business Research Institute ranked the group No. 2 in its August Star Brand Reputation Rankings (Aug 29), and Billboard's World Albums chart carried four BTS catalog titles for the week ending Aug 29 — 'Proof,' 'Love Yourself: Answer,' 'Map of the Soul: 7 ~The Journey~,' and 'Love Yourself: Tear.' The tour's North American leg resumes at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles (Sept 1, 2, 5, 6).
heroHeadline: Day 4,826: BTS Ranks No. 2 in August Brand Rankings, Places Four Albums on Billboard Chart
heroSubtitle: August 30, 2026 is Day 4,826 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. With the ARIRANG World Tour on a brief pause between the Chicago Soldier Field stand (Aug 27-28) and the Los Angeles SoFi Stadium dates (Sept 1, 2, 5, 6), the Korean Business Research Institute's August Star Brand Reputation Rankings placed BTS second overall with a brand reputation index of 9,495,066, a 16.77% rise from July. Billboard's World Albums chart for the week ending Aug 29 showed four BTS catalog titles still charting: 'Proof' (No. 7, week 219), 'Love Yourself: Answer' (No. 10, week 202), 'Map of the Soul: 7 ~The Journey~' (No. 12, week 42), and 'Love Yourself: Tear' (No. 22, week 221).
